when-first-landing-on-wyrmscraig.npc: Hey, who are you, and what are you doing here?!

when-first-landing-on-wyrmscraig.player: Oh, I just found this place while exploring the seas.

when-first-landing-on-wyrmscraig.npc: Hmm... We don't like outsiders here...

when-first-landing-on-wyrmscraig.player: So am I not allowed to be here?

when-first-landing-on-wyrmscraig.npc: Well... I can't stop you, I suppose. I don't have the authority to do so... or the ability to, I guess. But make no mistake, I'll be keeping a close eye on you.

after-completing-fallen-from-grace.npc: So, you're the one that went and found Keenan?
That's good of you. Not often an outsider does something to help us out here on the island. You going to stick around and offer us more help?
